subject.title: fix(backup): sweep stale temp artifacts before creating new backup

question: Should backup startup cleanup automatically delete stale OpenClaw-owned temp artifacts after the grace window once the timestamped-output matcher is fixed?
rationale: The code defect is mechanically repairable, but the remaining cleanup policy changes how old partial backup artifacts are treated on existing hosts.

options.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup
options.body: Proceed with the startup sweep after it covers timestamped output names and keeps UUID, age, output-directory, and live-owner guards.

options.title: Keep Artifacts For Manual Recovery
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers want interrupted backup artifacts to remain operator-visible until a separate recovery/debugging policy exists.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup
recommendation.body: Proceed with the startup sweep after it covers timestamped output names and keeps UUID, age, output-directory, and live-owner guards.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the current backup infra boundary and original backup review context.
